description: This PHP source file manages the Web UI for configuring WPS (Wi-Fi Protected Setup) on a wireless network router. It includes server-side logic for retrieving current WPS settings, as well as client-side JavaScript for the interactive UI that allows enabling/disabling WPS, selecting connection methods, and initiating pairing actions.

methods.name: validChecksum
methods.description: Validates the checksum of a provided WPS PIN, ensuring it conforms to the standard checksum rules for PIN verification.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sends AJAX requests to configure WPS settings on the device, such as enabling/disabling WPS, setting PIN, and pairing actions.
